title: Psalms 144

verses.text: David's praise of God as his all-sufficient help is enhanced by a recognition of the intrinsic worthlessness of man.
Confidently imploring God's interposition against his enemies, he breaks forth into praise and joyful anticipations of the prosperity of his kingdom, when freed from vain and wicked men.
